combo.description: To duel opponents AA and instantly E Q W. Mid cast of W Flash backwards and quickly use your R.
Inputting these commands quickly can cancel the animations. AA and quickly E Q W then AA
To finish low health opponents when you have your fourth shot up, Flash then instantly Q AA.
To burst targets AA then instantly E W right after one another, AA twice and finish up with a Q fourth shot AA
Trade normally by AA three times then Q right before using your final shot.
To keep your target locked in range while you trade AA then quickly W, then AA Q and AA twice more for your 4th shot.
